summary: Public projects created on 23 November 2025: 2 repos.
intro: Two repositories cover speech recognition tooling: a GUI for collecting audio and text into organised training datasets, and a validated script for fine-tuning Whisper on Modal GPUs with preformatted audio data.

projects.name: ASR Training Data Collector
projects.description: GUI to facilitate gathering training data for ASR/STT apps in organised datasets with audio capture, text capture, and JSONL metadata construction. Supports LLM-generated text and user-provided.

projects.name: Modal Whisper Finetune Script
projects.description: Validated fine-tuning script for fine-tuning Whisper on Modal GPU with a preformatted audio dataset
